330	What is the logic? At first glance it sounds a bit exaggerated. What is
331	the logic? The logic is simple: matter, as is known, is
332	a kind of illusion. We see matter as something
333	real because that is what we perceive with our eyes. But
334	in truth, matter is a kind of illusion.
335	Even in science they are beginning to understand this. They know
336	that all matter is made of atoms, which are tiny particles
337	that are all packed one next to
338	the other. On the tip of a pin, how many atoms are there at the finest
339	point? How many atoms are there? You have to write the number
340	three and then 15 zeros. That is the number of atoms
341	on the tip of a pin. And what is each atom made of?
342	A nucleus inside and electrons that circle around it
343	at speed, and then they create the illusion of a shell. Like
344	a fan: it has blades, but when it spins
345	fast you see a disc. The disc is an illusion. It
346	looks like a solid, but it is not solid, it is only
347	the speed. Electrons move at speed
348	and create the illusion of a shell, and when there are billions
349	of billions of them packed together, we see
350	matter. Physicists claim: what would happen if
351	the electrons stopped
352	their motion? What would happen? The whole universe
353	would disappear. They claim that the real matter of the entire planet
354	Earth could fit into a matchbox. That is the
355	real matter that exists. All the rest is imagination. It is a kind
356	of... Since matter is imagination, the masters of
357	the secret teach that the pleasures we enjoy are also a kind of
